words.connotation: negative, implies unreliability or lack of control
misconceptions: confusing it with simply strange or weird

words.sense: deviating from conventional or established patterns
words.connotation: neutral to slightly positive, implies individuality
misconceptions: thinking it means crazy or unpredictable

semantic_axes.description: Erratic behavior lacks a pattern; eccentric behavior follows a consistent, albeit unconventional, pattern.
Erratic is about stability; eccentric is about adherence to social norms.

edge.boundary_rule: If the behavior follows a strange pattern, use eccentric. If the behavior lacks a discernible pattern, use erratic.
irrelevant_clues: how much others like the person

erratic: The startup's revenue was erratic throughout the year.
His attendance has been erratic lately, causing him to miss classes.
Driving in such erratic conditions is dangerous.
The team's performance has been too erratic to win the championship.
Her mood swings were so erratic that no one knew how to approach her.
The signal from the router is erratic, dropping frequently.
eccentric: He is known for his eccentric taste in vintage furniture.
The professor's eccentric teaching style made his lectures popular.
She has an eccentric habit of collecting only blue stones.
His eccentric fashion sense sets him apart from his peers.
The inventor lived in an eccentric house he built himself.
Despite her eccentric ways, she is a brilliant engineer.

erratic: She wears a hat every single day; she is quite erratic.
The artist's style is erratic; he always paints circles.
He eats the same lunch every day; he is quite erratic.
The movie was erratic, following a very logical, structured plot.
His habits are erratic because he keeps the same routine daily.
The clock is erratic, ticking perfectly every second.
eccentric: He stops and starts abruptly; his driving is very eccentric.
The stock market is eccentric today, plunging and soaring wildly.
Her attendance is eccentric; she never knows if she will show up.
The weather is eccentric, changing from sun to rain every hour.
His moods are eccentric, shifting violently without warning.
The connection is eccentric, cutting out randomly.

borderline.text: The musician's performance style is so _____ that audiences never know what to expect next.
borderline.note: Could be eccentric if it meant they always perform weirdly, but 'never know what to expect' highlights unpredictability.

borderline.text: Mr. Lee is quite _____; he always wears a tuxedo to the beach.
The project's progress is _____; some weeks we finish nothing, others we finish a lot.
borderline.note: This lack of stable pattern is the definition of erratic.

borderline.text: Sara's handwriting is _____; it is backwards and uses unusual symbols, but it is always the same style.
borderline.note: It's consistently odd, not randomly changing.

chains.frame: The way Marcus participates in class is ___.

beats.text: Marcus frequently interrupts the professor to ask unrelated questions.
Marcus continues to wear a costume every day and brings a stuffed animal, behaving in this unusual way consistently.

chains.feedback_short: The behavior is consistently strange, fitting the definition of eccentric perfectly.
chains.feedback_deep: Even though Marcus's behavior is unusual, it is consistent. Eccentric refers to unconventional behavior, whereas erratic implies a lack of pattern.
chains.contrast_rule: Consistent weirdness is eccentric, chaotic randomness is erratic.
chains.hint: Is his behavior changing all the time, or is it just consistently strange?

chains.frame: The way Sam drives is ___.

beats.text: Sam suddenly accelerates, then brakes, then swerves without any apparent traffic conditions.
Sam keeps changing lanes randomly, making it impossible for other drivers to anticipate his next move.

chains.feedback_short: Sam's driving lacks any pattern, making it erratic.
chains.feedback_deep: Driving that suddenly speeds up, slows down, and changes lanes unpredictably is the definition of erratic. Eccentric would imply a consistent, albeit odd, driving habit.
chains.hint: Can you predict what Sam will do next?

chains.frame: The way Mia communicates is ___.

beats.text: Mia uses archaic language, speaks in rhymes, and always talks about the 18th century.
Mia now sometimes whispers, sometimes shouts, and sometimes just stops in the middle of a sentence, with no apparent logic.

chains.feedback_short: Mia's speech patterns changed from consistently odd to completely unpredictable.
chains.feedback_deep: Initially, Mia's speech was quirky but predictable. When it became chaotic and illogical, it shifted to erratic.
chains.contrast_rule: Consistent quirkiness flips to erratic when chaos enters.

chains.frame: The way the project manager leads is ___.

beats.text: The manager insists on conducting all meetings while standing on a desk.
The manager never changes this weird habit, though he is very reliable and predictable otherwise.

chains.feedback_short: The behavior is strange but very predictable.
chains.feedback_deep: Eccentricity does not imply unpredictability. Reliable, stable, but unconventional behavior is eccentric.
chains.contrast_rule: Reliability makes it eccentric, not erratic.

chains.frame: The way the tennis player serves is ___.

beats.text: Before every serve, the player spins the ball three times and whispers to it.
beats.reason: It is a consistent, strange routine.

beats.text: Sometimes he spins it, sometimes he throws it on the ground, sometimes he just walks away, with no pattern at all.

chains.feedback_short: The routine changed from a consistent habit to a random set of actions.
chains.feedback_deep: Consistency in weirdness is eccentric; chaos or randomness is erratic.
chains.contrast_rule: If you can't find a pattern, it's erratic.

chains.frame: The way my roommate decorates the kitchen is ___.

beats.text: She paints the walls purple and hangs old bicycle wheels from the ceiling.
beats.reason: It is an unconventional but fixed design.

beats.text: While it remains very strange, it is clearly a deliberate, planned, and unchanging design choice.
beats.reason: It highlights the consistency of the design.

chains.feedback_short: The design is strange, but clearly intentional and stable.
chains.feedback_deep: Eccentricity describes a deviation from the norm, but it can be very stable. Erratic requires unpredictability, which this design lacks.

chains.frame: The way Kenji tells stories is ___.

beats.text: Kenji always acts out every character's voice in a very dramatic, exaggerated way.
Even after years, he never fails to use these same exaggerated, odd voices.

chains.feedback_short: His habits are very stable, just unusual.
chains.feedback_deep: Eccentric implies a consistent, albeit odd, way of doing things. Erratic would mean he changes his style constantly.
chains.hint: Are the stories told in the same weird way?

chains.frame: The way the street performer sings is ___.

beats.text: He only sings songs backwards, which is certainly different and unexpected.
Today, he is screaming, whispering, and jumping around, with no relation to the songs he sings.

chains.feedback_short: The performance shifted from a consistent gimmick to chaotic, unpredictable behavior.
chains.feedback_deep: The first behavior was an odd gimmick (eccentric). The second behavior lacks any discernible pattern, making it erratic.

chains.frame: The way the researcher organizes her data is ___.

beats.text: She color-codes everything based on the temperature outside when she collected the data.
beats.reason: It's a strange but orderly system.

beats.text: Her colleagues are baffled, but they admit her weird filing system is perfectly logical once explained.
beats.reason: It confirms the system is stable.

chains.feedback_short: The system is logical, just very unusual.
chains.feedback_deep: Consistency and logic, even when unconventional, point to eccentric, not erratic.

chains.frame: The way the tour guide navigates is ___.

beats.text: He refuses to use maps and instead chooses his route based on the color of the flowers he sees.
beats.reason: It is a consistent, strange rule.

beats.text: Sometimes he stops, sometimes he runs, sometimes he goes back, completely ignoring the flowers or any logic.

chains.feedback_short: The guide went from using a strange rule to acting randomly.
chains.feedback_deep: The first method was weird but consistent (eccentric). The second method was completely random (erratic).

chains.frame: The way my cousin dresses is ___.

beats.text: He insists on wearing three watches on one arm and a hat indoors at all times.
It is his signature look; everyone knows him by those watches and that hat.

chains.feedback_short: His fashion style is consistent, though very unusual.
chains.feedback_deep: Eccentricity implies a stable, unique way of being. erratic would imply he changes his style suddenly and unpredictably.

chains.frame: The way the accountant does his job is ___.

beats.text: He uses a typewriter and ledger books from 1950, refusing to use a computer.
Now he suddenly starts destroying files, then rebuilding them, with no pattern to his work at all.

chains.feedback_short: The work behavior flipped from a consistent, weird preference to unpredictable, chaotic actions.
chains.feedback_deep: Initially, the accountant had a consistent (eccentric) method. Then, he acted unpredictably (erratic).

chains.frame: The way my neighbor talks is ___.

beats.text: She greets everyone by saying 'The stars are aligned!' instead of 'Hello'.
It is undeniably strange, but she is completely predictable, as she has done this for ten years.

chains.feedback_short: Strange, but extremely stable and predictable.
chains.feedback_deep: Eccentric behavior can be extremely predictable. The predictability is the key factor ruling out erratic.

chains.frame: The way the student writes essays is ___.

beats.text: He insists on starting every essay with a quote from a cookbook.
While unusual, the structure of his essays is always solid, logical, and highly predictable.

chains.feedback_short: Strange hook, but a stable and solid essay structure.
chains.feedback_deep: Eccentricity is about oddity, not chaos. A consistent structure rules out erratic.

chains.frame: The way the explorer acts is ___.

beats.text: He always wears his sunglasses at night and carries a compass even in cities.
Some might think this makes him unreliable, but his habits are actually incredibly fixed and predictable.

chains.feedback_short: His habits appear unpredictable to some, but they are actually very stable.
chains.feedback_deep: Even if something looks chaotic, if it's actually a fixed routine, it's eccentric, not erratic.

chains.frame: The way my roommate prepares dinner is ___.

beats.text: She refuses to use cutlery and eats everything with her hands while standing up.
beats.reason: It is a consistent, strange rule.

beats.text: It might look like a chaotic or random habit, but she has done this every single night for years without exception.

chains.feedback_short: It looks strange and potentially chaotic, but it is a consistent daily habit.
chains.feedback_deep: Even if a behavior seems unhinged, its consistency makes it eccentric rather than erratic.

chains.frame: The way the consultant acts is ___.

beats.text: He arrives at different times each day, sometimes in a suit, sometimes in casual clothes.
Actually, he follows a complex but deliberate schedule based on the client's needs, which he always adheres to perfectly.
beats.reason: The pattern is explained, so it's not erratic.

chains.feedback_short: What appeared random is actually a well-planned, deliberate system.
chains.feedback_deep: When we learn there is a deliberate, consistent plan, the behavior is revealed to be eccentric, not erratic.

chains.frame: The way my friend acts is ___.

beats.text: She always drinks her coffee with salt, claiming it improves the taste.
Lately, she drinks it with salt, then sugar, then pepper, then nothing, constantly changing what she does for no reason.

chains.feedback_short: The behavior went from a weird, stable habit to completely random changes.
chains.feedback_deep: Stability (eccentric) was corrupted by chaotic change (erratic).

chains.frame: The way my brother manages his time is ___.

beats.text: He spends hours cleaning at midnight, then sleeps all day, then works all night.
Actually, he follows a strict, well-documented cycle that repeats perfectly every 48 hours.
beats.reason: The pattern is revealed, so it's consistent.

chains.feedback_short: What seemed chaotic is actually a rigid, repeating cycle.
chains.feedback_deep: Erratic behavior is unpredictable. Once a strict, consistent cycle is revealed, the behavior is better described as eccentric.

chains.frame: The way the lecturer speaks is ___.

beats.text: She uses a very formal, archaic accent that most people find strange.
beats.reason: It is a consistent, odd habit.

beats.text: She is deeply intellectual, and this way of speaking is just a quirky part of her personality, consistent for her whole life.

chains.feedback_short: The speech pattern is a stable, quirky personality trait, not unpredictable behavior.
chains.feedback_deep: Erratic would imply instability. Eccentric accurately captures the consistent but odd nature of her speech.
chains.hint: Is it just a stable quirk?
